{{short description|Russian mathematician}}
'''Alexander S. Dynin''' (Александр С. Дынин, born 1936) is a Russian mathematician at [[Ohio State University]] who introduced the [[Agranovich–Dynin formula]]. Since 2009, Dynin claims to have proved the [[Yang–Mills existence and mass gap|Yang-Mills Millennium Problem]].<ref name=Dynin>{{cite arXiv |last=Dynin |first=A |year=2009 |title=Energy-mass spectrum of Yang-Mills bosons is infinite and discrete |class=math-ph |eprint=0903.4727}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=https://marcofrasca.wordpress.com/2010/11/17/the-many-faces-of-qcd-3/|title=The many faces of QCD (3)|date=November 17, 2010}}</ref><ref name=Dynin2>
